command: pre-registration: failure map F1-F5, before typing aggregates and stage-B fits/rollouts

metrics.F1: zs binding-error rate rises with task CD (11 combination pick-and-place tasks): Spearman rho > 0, one-sided permutation p (100000)
metrics.F2: (a) lora1000 k=1 wrong-object episodes start farther from the demo grasp point (within-task label permutation, 20000, one-sided) AND (b) lora1000 wrong-object k=1 > k=10 (paired one-sided exact sign test); p = max
metrics.F3: zs typed failures on instance tasks 14/16/60/38: instance-role binding errors > 0.5 (cluster bootstrap); < 10 failures -> not testable
metrics.F4: 13 part pick-and-place tasks: motion share of typed failures > 0.5 for create AND lora1000 (cluster bootstrap; p = max)
metrics.F5: compose_sel induced failures (zs success -> compose_sel failure, composed pick-and-place tasks): binding-error share > 0.5 (cluster bootstrap); < 10 -> not testable
metrics.disclosure: M1 per-task success read before; 16 hand-checked episodes' types seen (listed in the script docstring); one python3 --version on the login node
metrics.secondary: type shares by arm x axis (bin, kind, scene_familiar, instance); success-vs-k curve; create_k5 vs lora_k5_1000; logistic slope of success on CD per arm; composition cards

stage_b.settings: M1's (r16, lr 1e-4, batch 32; token n4 lr 1e-2 1000 steps)
stage_b.states: fresh_m1, 20 per task, noise seed 13, paired with M1

metrics.types: fixture / no_commit / wrong_object (wrong_instance) / wrong_goal (other_region | carried_elsewhere) / motion (toward_target | not_carried | in_region); settle 10 steps, carried >= 0.10 m, half way 0.5
metrics.written_before: any typed aggregate, stage-B fit or rollout
